samples.summary: Persisted theme value is cast (`as Theme`) without validation and flows into `root.classList.add(theme)` — a poisoned storage entry gives persistent DOM class injection / app-wide crash
samples.evidence: `readStoredTheme(storageKey) as Theme` (theme-provider.tsx:65) does no runtime validation; the value is passed unchecked to `root.classList.add(theme)` at theme-provider.tsx:87. Any attacker who can run same-origin script once (a stored/reflected XSS elsewhere in the app, a malicious browser extension, or a shared kiosk browser) can write `localStorage['vite-ui-theme'] = 'evil-class'` or a value containing a space; the former attaches an attacker-chosen class to `<html>` on every subsequent load (CSS-based exfil/clickjacking surface if any injected stylesheet exists), the latter makes `classList.add` throw `InvalidCharacterError` from the layout effect, unmounting the React tree on every load — a persistent client-side DoS that survives reloads and is not clearable from the UI. The new `date-format-preference.ts` gets this right (`isFormat` at line 26 validates the stored value on read); the theme path, whose read this diff rewrapped, still does not. Fix: validate against `"light" | "dark" | "system"` inside `readStoredTheme`. Requires a prior same-origin write, hence medium confidence on exploitability.

samples.summary: `setDateFormat` is an exported write boundary with no runtime validation of its argument — arbitrary strings can be persisted under the app's storage key
samples.evidence: `setDateFormat` (date-format-preference.ts:63) writes whatever it is handed straight to `localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, format)`; the only caller passes `value as DateDisplayFormat` from the Radix Select (settings/page.tsx:71), so the type is TypeScript-only and erased at runtime. Impact is contained because `getDateFormat` validates on read via `isFormat` (line 26/51) and falls back to the default, so a junk value cannot reach rendering — hence nit, not a vulnerability. Hardening: reuse `isFormat` at the write boundary so the persisted key can never hold an unexpected value.
searchedFor: grep for `wafflebase-date-format` and `date-format-preference` across the repo (only settings/page.tsx, document-list.tsx, document-list-utils.ts and the tests reference it)
read date-format-preference.ts in full to confirm no validation in setDateFormat
